result.summary: Found 3 visual issues on the food delivery app page, including a truncated restaurant card, a duplicate listing, and a partially visible category filter.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Smash Bros Bu...') is cut off on the right side, truncating both the image and the restaurant name text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container shows a clear peek of the next card without cutting off text. Add proper padding or adjust card width so the truncation is more intentional and readable.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' listings with the same delivery time (15-25 min) and price (€0.90), which appears to be a duplicate entry rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source to ensure duplicate restaurant entries are not being rendered. If these are different branches, differentiate them with branch names or addresses.

issues.description: The last category filter pill in the horizontal filter row (after 'Healthy') is partially visible and cut off, with no visual indicator (like a fade or arrow) to hint that the list is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or a visible scroll indicator at the edge of the filter row to communicate that more categories are available by scrolling.
